name: Question 2
problem:
Find the missing values in the following table:

| Sentence | Symbolic Form |
| --- | --- |
| {{field-1}} | $B⇒A$ |
| {{field-2}} | $A⇒B$ |
| {{field-3}} | $A⇒B$ |
| {{field-4}} | $B⇒A$ |
worked_solution:
Let's recall the following grammatical constructions for the implication $P⇒Q:$

- If $P,$ then $Q$

- $P$ only if $Q$

- $Q$ if $P$

- $P$ implies $Q$

Let's now compare these against the entries in our table:

- "If $B,$ then $A$" means $B⇒A$

- "$A$ only if $B$" means $A⇒B$

- "$B$ if $A$" means $A⇒B$

- "$B$ implies $A$" means $B⇒A$

The completed table is shown below.

| Sentence | Symbolic Form |
| --- | --- |
| If $B,$ then $A$ | $B⇒A$ |
| $A$ only if $B$ | $A⇒B$ |
| $B$ if $A$ | $A⇒B$ |
| $B$ implies $A$ | $B⇒A$ |

EXPLANATION

Let's recall the following grammatical constructions for the implication P⇒Q:

  • If P, then Q

  • P only if Q

  • Q if P

  • P implies Q

Let's now compare these against the entries in our table:

  • "If B, then A" means B⇒A

  • "A only if B" means A⇒B

  • "B if A" means A⇒B

  • "B implies A" means B⇒A

The completed table is shown below.

Sentence Symbolic Form
If B, then A B⇒A
A only if B A⇒B
B if A A⇒B
B implies A B⇒A
